cues.text: The dorm rooftop. A watermelon sits on a mat with a baseball bat lying beside it. You and Junpei stand by the mat; Ken and Koromaru stand across from you.
Koromaru trots onto the mat and plants himself over the watermelon.
Akihiko steps out through the rooftop door and comes over to the group.
Akihiko raises his fists and walks up to the watermelon. Akihiko drops to one knee and smashes the watermelon with his fist. Chunks of it scatter across the mat.
Later, you and Junpei are alone on the rooftop.
